proposal.text: DECISION 2: YES, the "Do not glob" comment at scripts/offline-runner.mjs:1 is justified. scripts/ contains scripts that launch live model seats — scripts/sandbox-claude-live.ts:62 spawn("claude", ...), scripts/bench-steer-claude.ts:65 spawn("claude", ...), scripts/adjudicator-trial.ts:41 spawn("claude", ["-p", ...]) — and scripts that bind network ports, e.g. scripts/openrouter-smoke.ts:103 stub.listen(STUB_PORT) on a fixed port. None of these is in the explicit offlineScripts list (scripts/offline-runner.mjs:26-182; only adjudicator-trial.test.ts at :36), so a glob over scripts/ would pull live, costly or port-conflicting runs into the offline suite.

challenge.objection: The weakest part is "a glob over scripts/ would pull live, costly or port-conflicting runs". Your examples (sandbox-claude-live.ts, bench-steer-claude.ts, openrouter-smoke.ts) aren't *.test.ts or *-regression.ts files, so a narrow glob would skip them. The comment stays justified anyway: unlisted bench-harness.test.ts:39 and bench-seat.test.ts:31 bind port pairs, so even `*.test.ts` would pull in port binders. Please amend to add that.
